C1559.title: Time Tells All: Deanonymization of Blockchain RPC Users
C1559.summary: This paper details a zero-transaction-fee de-anonymization attack that correlates blockchain RPC users' IP addresses with their on-chain pseudonyms by analyzing ledger data. Large-scale measurements and real-world attacks validate its effectiveness, exposing privacy leakage risks inherent in blockchain transaction transparency.
